name: Mitchell Robinson
detail: Robinson (illness) is out for Tuesday's game against Washington, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

name: Moritz Wagner
detail: Wagner (knee) will not return to Wednesday's game against the Bucks, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.

name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
detail: Kalkbrenner (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's matchup with Chicago.

name: Grayson Allen
detail: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Chicago.

name: Dennis Schroder
detail: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

name: Jalen Smith
detail: Smith (illness) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Charlotte.

name: Tobi Lawal
detail: Lawal (groin) is out for Tuesday's game against Denver.

name: Jalen Duren
detail: Detroit recalled Duren (hamstring) from the G League's Motor City Cruise on Wednesday.

name: Cade Cunningham
detail: Cunningham (knee) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

name: Ebuka Okorie
detail: The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.

name: Taurean Prince
detail: Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Duncan Robinson
detail: Robinson (quadriceps) is considered day-to-day as he progresses in his rehab, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Stephen Curry
detail: Curry (abdomen) will be re-evaluated Friday after Thanksgiving, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

name: T.J. McConnell
detail: McConnell (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
detail: Haliburton (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Aaron Nesmith
detail: Nesmith is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to right foot soreness.

name: Larry Nance Jr.
detail: Nance exited Monday's game against the Thunder due to a sore right ankle and he will not return, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Austin Reaves
detail: Reaves (heel) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.

name: Zach Edey
detail: Edey (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 115-97 win over the Clippers. He finished with seven points (3-4 FG, 1-1 FT), four rebounds, two assists and two blocks across nine minutes.

name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
detail: Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

name: Cameron Boozer
detail: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: LaMelo Ball
detail: Ball (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 113-106 win over the Thunder.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Julian Reese
detail: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.

name: Miles McBride
detail: McBride (adductor) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

name: Andre Drummond
detail: Drummond (head) did not return to Wednesday's 121-102 win over the Cavaliers.

name: OG Anunoby
detail: Anunoby (calf) participated in on-court work for the first time since sustaining the injury, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.

name: Jordan Clarkson
detail: Clarkson (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.

name: Nikola Topic
detail: Topic (hip) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus Minnesota.

name: Jaylin Williams
detail: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

name: Aday Mara
detail: Mara (leg) is out for Wednesday's game versus the Timberwolves.

name: Jalen Williams
detail: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

name: Colin Castleton
detail: Castleton totaled five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt) and four rebounds in seven minutes during Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over the Cavaliers.

name: Joel Embiid
detail: Embiid (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against Miami, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

name: Jaylen Brown
detail: Brown (hamstring) will receive imaging, and the Sixers will provide an update Thursday, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

name: Zach LaVine
detail: LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.

name: Maxime Raynaud
detail: Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

name: De'Aaron Fox
detail: Fox (shin) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

name: Kawhi Leonard
detail: Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

name: Jaxson Hayes
detail: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.
